title: CIAR: Interval-based Collaborative Decoding for Image Generation Acceleration

layout.note: Two panels side by side split by a dashed vertical line: (a) a pie chart over a bar chart at left, (b) three equal-width columns at right, each a bottom-up stack with a clock badge on top, titles under both panels.

lesson: Put a small measured motivation panel (pie and dual-axis bars) next to a row of identical layer-stack lanes that add one component each, and hang a clock badge with seconds and percentage saved above every lane so the efficiency claim is read first.
